name: Ceres
source:
She is a talented woman who combines popularity, bravery and beauty. She is a hard-nosed, fastidious person who never overlooks injustice. 

She not only leads the Knights, but also participates in national politics as a member of the Senate. She and Yuri trained together in the knighthood when they were children. 

Therefore, she is well acquainted with Yuri's personality and is vehemently opposed to his succession to the throne. 

She is secretly in love with Kristof, but has given up on the idea that it is a love that is attainable.

[From [url=https://frill.product.co.jp/frill03/chara.html]official site[/url]]
